notes: Three own pages read, all HTTP 200 and not flagged thin. The innago.com pricing and home pages are client rendered: their snapshots carry only the tagline, reviews and the line No monthly fee. No setup fee. No contract.; the fee details come from the Innago FAQ at nextapp-dev.innago.com, an Innago subdomain that an answer cites (last updated July 14, 2026). A reviewer may wish to confirm the FAQ figures on the production site in a browser. The FAQ also states founding (2017), headquarters (Cincinnati), a mobile app, cloud hosting and QuickBooks and Ledgre integrations, but no answer made those claims about Innago (one q9 answer lists Innago and Ledgre as platforms to integrate with, which is not a claim about Innago). Three cited pages were read for causes: an Agora comparison carries the free basic access with optional paid features wording; the Re-Leased article lists e-signatures as a feature beside revenue from optional services but does not say e-signatures are paid, so C10 is cause not found. Several Google AI Overviews answers print vendor headings after their blocks, so unlabelled blocks were not attributed to Innago; only lines that name Innago, or follow an Innago heading directly, were coded. Hedged lines (may find, in many cases), rankings and only-free-option comparisons were not coded. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser snapshot exists for Innago, so nothing was re-classed on new reads. The three gap lines, every markdown and Google-style table naming Innago and every Innago-headed section were checked; each in-scope line is already an instance (for example the free, tenant-paid and no-unit-cap table cells), so no claim or instance was added. The q6 Google AI Overviews comparison table was left uncoded because its header names three vendors over four value columns, so the Innago column cannot be identified. Consistency check: C09 and C10 stay wrong, because the FAQ says landlords get full access to all features for free and that the only fees are tenant transaction and screening fees, which explicitly contradicts paid features, premium add-ons and paid e-signatures; that FAQ sits on the nextapp-dev.innago.com subdomain, which a reviewer should keep in mind.
